message: This has a lot of high-throughput event triggers, make it a scheduled task for 12am every day.
text:
Notes Improver is now a scheduled task at 00:00 every day (version 9, changes c9.0 to c9.5). I removed its four event triggers (`gate.landed`, `changes.requested`, `gate.rejected`, `gate.conflict`), so it no longer wakes on each event. Each night it reads the DONE and REJECTED tickets and the gate results since the last run, works out why they were rejected or failed, and sends ideas to the Coordinator as `work.requested`.

I don't have your time zone, so the run follows the host's clock for now. Which zone should 00:00 be in? Also still open: which of the two duplicate drafts (`notes_files_improver` or `notes_improver`) to keep, and whether to keep the notes-files counter.

quotes: make it a scheduled task for 12am every day
